about_short_description.short_description: EasyLease is a leasing solution company that provides solutions for motorcycle fleets.

product.name: Motorcycle Fleet Leasing and Rental
product.description: Leasing and rental of motorcycles for delivery companies, rider programs, corporates, SMEs, government organizations, and individual users.

product.name: Fleet Leasing and Rental Programs
product.description: Leasing and rental of cars, motorcycles, and other vehicles through flexible fleet programs for businesses, government organizations, and individuals.

product.name: Delivery and Last-Mile Logistics
product.description: Last-mile and on-demand delivery services connecting merchants, riders, and customers, supported by managed delivery fleets and dispatch operations.

product.name: Warehousing and Third-Party Logistics
product.description: Warehousing, distribution, and third-party logistics services for businesses requiring storage, inventory handling, fulfillment, and transportation coordination.

product.name: Automotive Logistics
product.description: Finished-vehicle storage, preparation, distribution, spare-parts logistics, and vehicle customization services for automotive manufacturers, importers, and dealers.

product.name: Roadside Assistance and Vehicle Recovery
product.description: Roadside assistance, vehicle recovery, and 24-hour response services for fleets, mobility operators, and vehicle users.
